messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The red lantern above the station door swings hard in the wind.

Tessa Rowe points to a marked lodge on the storm map.

(Tessa Rowe) "Roof collapse. Two guests unaccounted for. We move now or the pass closes without us."
